description:
Refactor the 'processTransaction' method in 'PaymentProcessor.java' to use a Parameter Object pattern. Currently, the method takes 7 arguments (merchantId, amount, currency, cardNum, cvv, expiry, note). You must:

1. Use the 'Introduce Parameter Object' refactoring (or manual equivalent).
2. Create a new class named 'TransactionRequest' to hold these fields.
3. Ensure 'PaymentProcessor.processTransaction' accepts a single 'TransactionRequest' argument.
4. Ensure all calling code (App.java, PaymentServiceTest.java) is updated to use the new object.
5. Verify the project compiles and tests pass.
